verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is built to be driven conversationally through the user's own agent. It ships an MCP server and CLI skill files for Codex and Claude Code, and its docs describe asking the agent to handle processes such as incorporation and payroll. However, it runs no model itself, so natural-language understanding comes from the host agent, and no hands-on natural-language session over the MCP server has been observed past its auth wall. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface, an observed end-to-end conversational session operating hosted processes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
